reviews.text:
I’ve been using Smart Paws for about a year now to watch my cats when I travel, and they’ve been great every single time. I rarely leave reviews, but this one was definitely warranted.

Scheduling drop-in visits is a breeze, and they’re always super communicative. I love that they send updates and photos every visit, so I always know what’s going on. I know it can be tough to find a company you feel comfortable trusting with your animals, but I’ve never had any hesitation with Smart Paws.

I also have to call out Gina specifically because she’s awesome to work with for scheduling and everything else. She’s incredibly responsive, always on top of things, and you can tell she genuinely cares.

If you need a pet sitter/walker, I genuinely can’t recommend the Smart Paws team enough.

Smart paws is the best!!! A new job had me searching for a solution to long days in the office and Gina and her crew couldn’t have made it easier. So professional, caring and fun! Getting pictures and a note from my girl’s walks have become my favorite time of day. Thanks Gina!

Smart Paws is the best! Gina is truly outstanding — caring, reliable, and always made sure my dog Bo was well taken care of. Whether it was daily walks or overnight stays, Gina and her team consistently provided top-notch care and attention.

I recently moved away from Chicago, and I really wish I had a Smart Paws (and a Gina!) where I am now.

If you’re looking for someone you can fully trust with your pet — call her!

These guys were the best they treated Felix as though he was their own and a big shoutout to Gina specifically she was so amazing to work with 10/10 would tell all friends n fam to go w them for any and all pet ,sitting, walking, etc needs

Working long hours while having a puppy is not easy. Thank goodness Smart Paws has been there to help over this past year. Always incredible service with all of the walkers and especially Gina. They are all such loving, kind and knowledgeable animal lovers!  They have been so helpful with giving me tips as a new puppy mom.  Smart Paws has also been very flexible when I’m working unexpected late shifts and will come walk my big baby Moose last minute. The pictures sent are an added bonus. Thanks Smart Paws!!

If you are looking for a place to care for your sweet pets, look no further! Smart Paws took care of my pups, JD and Lila, while I was on a weekend trip. Gina and her team were sure to give plenty of updates with photos which helped me feel so comfortable while away. I will definitely be reaching out to them the next time we have a trip planned.
I absolutely love this dog walking service! They are always on time and take such good care of my sweet baby girl. I recommend Smart Paws to all my friends and they do too!

Gina and Smart Paws are AMAZING!! They took such good care of my cat 8-bit for about a week while I was on vacation and I couldn't be happier with their service. 8-bit is a pretty shy girl and usually doesn't love strangers but she came out for cuddles and to hang every time they came over! She clearly felt very comfortable with them and that took a lot of stress off my back so I could really enjoy my vacation. Thank you Smart Paws!

My Cheesy recently spent the weekend with Gina and I came home to rave reviews! Cheesy said Gina took her on many walkies, provided plenty of treaties, welcomed snuggles and even had a fancy water dispenser she loved. Cheesy said 10/10 would recommend and stay again. Thank you, Gina, for making Cheesy’s vacation a great one!

I highly recommend Smart Paws! The software to book walks is so easy to use, and Gina and her team are absolutely wonderful! My pup Margot always looks happy on her walks (they send pics and updates), and I feel so safe having them come into my home and walk her.
Smart Paws has been great with my dog, Lulu. The walkers are super reliable and treat her like their own, making sure she’s happy and well cared for. I don’t have to worry about a thing!

We've been using Gina and Smart Paws for dog sitting services for just over two years now, and I 100% recommend them! My  senior pup (16y.o.) is a very high maintenance guy with special needs, and Gina is amazing with him!!! He is always super relaxed and taken care of! Gina provides regular photos and video updates, and I 100% trust her. Couldn’t recommend more!
Truly, thank you, Gina, I can’t be more grateful for your help!

We've been using Gina and Smart Paws for dog sitting since last April, and they are fantastic! Our dog, Delilah, is afraid of people and very anxious, but she let Gina take her out on walks right from the start. Having someone we trust stay with Delilah and provide regular photos and updates gives us peace of mind and makes traveling much less stressful. Smart Paws is now our go-to any time we go away!

Photo credit to Gina, walking and caring for Delilah
I have a big anxious boy and Gina was fantastic with him! He has separation anxiety but after one visit he ran right in and was a happy boy. Gina updated me regularly and made me feel at ease.

Cannot speak highly enough about Smart Paws! We have been using their dog sitting services for a few years and when I say my dog loves Gina, I mean it! He’s practically jumping out of the car when he sees her.  Gina is very professional, responsive, and flexible if schedule changes pop up. I know my dog is in good hands with her, and I would trust any of the staff at Smart Paws as Gina only hires the best :)
Smart Paws is great! Gina is wonderful with my dog and has been very quick to respond. She has come through on very short notice as well!

Truly the best of the best!! I travel a lot for work and have been dealing with taking care of a sick family member. This means sometimes a last minute request. Gina and the Smart Paws team are lifesavers and have become an extension of our pack. My boys are always so happy and well cared for when I come home and they have been with Gina. Cannot recommend Smart Paws enough!!!

We used SmartPaws for the Thanksgiving holiday and were beyond pleased with how our two cats were cared for. The litter, food and water was all taken care of per our requests perfectly. They also sent daily pictures and you could tell there was sincere effort spent making our cats comfortable. The feeding dishes were also cleaned which I felt was very thoughtful.

I really couldn’t brag on SmartPaws enough! Will absolutely be using them again.

We’ve been using Smart Paws since July and couldn’t be more thrilled with their exceptional service and communication. Gina is incredibly responsive and professional, always addressing our questions or concerns promptly and effectively. We especially love the technology they use, which gives us check-ins, GPS tracking, and photo updates—it adds a personal touch and peace of mind. For the value they provide, the level of care and attention is outstanding. We couldn’t be happier and wholeheartedly recommend them!

I highly recommend Gina for her services!!  She has done an amazing job with my dog Thor, he loves seeing her for walks!  She always on time and yet flexible as things come up!! Your dogs are in great hands with Gina !!!

Smart Paws Chicago has been amazing for me and my dog, Henry! The team is reliable, caring, and always goes above and beyond. Henry gets the best care, and I love the detailed updates with adorable photos. Highly recommend this fantastic women-owned business!
Been using this service for the past 2 1/2 years and can't recommend them enough. They are flexible, accommodating and take great care of our pup. He is excited to see them every time they come.

Gina is the best! My dog, George, is not the easiest to handle. He can be aggressive towards people and other dogs. I was going on vacation for the first time without my pups. She made it look like it was easy. He took to her so quickly, which was super helpful because I was so anxious about leaving him with someone and something happening. Now I’m not bound to my home forever and can travel without worrying it’s too much! Grateful I have a trustworthy option for my babies!!

I can’t say enough great things about Smart Paws Chicago! Gina, the owner, is amazing—she truly loves what she does, and it shows. The whole team is super friendly and reliable, always making sure my dog gets the best care. Whether it’s a short walk or a longer outing, I know my pup is having a great time. If you’re looking for a down-to-earth, trustworthy dog walking service, Gina and Smart Paws Chicago are the way to go!

I have been using Smart Paws for 5 years now. They are the best - very flexible with walking options and always respond promptly to emails.
